summary: T03 implementation conforms to the saved plan: the shared first-run rendering contract exists with strict payload/remediation/issue models, pretty and JSON renderers expose stable reason codes and structured remediation, setup/start placeholders use the shared renderer while remaining placeholders, the first-run setup/source-checkout/credential/client/installer/start reason codes are cataloged and documented, redaction covers token-shaped values and provider refs in both pretty and JSON output, and the validation artifact records focused pytest, ruff, and mypy evidence while leaving broad AWF/GitHub validation to the post-agent phase.
